name: Swiss kinetic grid typography

source.description: Genre convention: International Typographic Style posters adapted to motion; strict grid, oversized grotesk, one signal colour.

technique: Words land on a visible grid with hard cuts, mask rises and character cascades; colour marks the key word.

decomposition.timing: Hard cuts on beats; 0.3-0.5 s entrances

provenance.observed: Neo-grotesque statements on a faint square grid, hard cuts on the beat alternating light and dark, lines rising in from a mask within about 2 frames.

Oversized grotesk caps with one italic serif word, corner labels framing every scene, one signal colour on the key word (2.6-3.4 s, 13.9 s); but only one hard cut in 15 s. Note: Partial fit: the typography and the grid frame match; the record's 'hard cuts on beats' does not (transitions are blooms, pushes and a zoom-through).

licensing_notes: Technique only. No specific artwork, footage, characters or compositions from any source are copied.
